title: Constellation Commit — payload
description: Once per mark per moon: up to 42 deliberate stars, as hashes only, sent to the shared stars chain with this moon's hidden star and a proof of work over everything committed. The members are exactly the body of the stars Worker's POST /constellation.

mark.description: The visitor's mark: sha256("mark|" + device secret). Before joining, equal to the document's issuer.

moon.description: The moon now open. The consumer refuses any other (notThisMoon).

stars.description: The constellation, in the order the stars are to be appended. Leaves must be distinct (duplicateStar; not expressible as uniqueItems because two stars could differ only in place).

type.description: The star's type. Only deliberate stars may be committed; passive ones never leave the browser.

leaf.description: The star's leaf: v2 = sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form of the star's Trust Task document; v1 = sha256 of JSON.stringify({type, content, at}).

place.description: OPTIONAL. The first path segment of the page the star was made on.

page.description: The page the hidden star was found on.

nonce.description: The proof-of-work nonce, written in decimal into sha256("pow|" + mark + "|" + moon + "|" + setRoot + "|" + egg.hash + "|" + nonce), which must have at least D leading zero bits (D = 16 in this version).

Hex256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.

MoonId.description: A moon: moon-YYYY-MM-DD, the UTC date of its new moon.

Place.description: A path segment of a public page, as the stars Worker accepts it.

first.description: Sequence number of the first appended star.

last.description: Sequence number of the last appended row, the egg/find row. last - first = stars.

head.description: The chain's head (newest link hash) after the append.

stars.description: How many stars were appended, not counting the egg/find row.
